messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert p12345 -> veritas-ai (dedicated pool eu-west-1): sudden spike in 5xx rate (service: model-serve). Alert level: page. Runbook: https://runbooks.redwood/internal/p12345

lia-oncall: taking this. @eng-sre-matt can you confirm any recent infra changes? spinning up fallback routing to shared-eu while I triage.

eng-sre-matt: seeing 5xx cluster wide on model-server-batch-3. Logs show repeated OOMs in quantized runtime after kernel patch deployed ~15m ago. Starting rollback of kernel config (kernel-r0 -> kernel-rprev) on two nodes now.

ops-lead-kate: noted. Please set status page to "degraded" for Veritas-AI dedicated pool and mark SLA impact. Prep customer-facing blurb.

support-amy: Draft customer blurb (tailored):
```
Short: We are investigating an issue affecting inference requests for Veritas-AI's dedicated pool in eu-west-1. Some requests may return errors or experience higher latency.
What we're doing: Rolling back a recent runtime kernel change and routing traffic to a shared fallback pool while we confirm stability.
Estimated recovery: 30-45 minutes (working on rollback and validation).
Contact: acct-mgr-josh@redwood.ai for escalation.
```

acct-mgr-josh: Received. Veritas escalation contacts to include in notice: englead@veritas.ai, infra@veritas.ai, support@veritas.ai. Ops phones (for paging): +1-415-555-0133 (US ops), +44-20-7946-0991 (EMEA ops). Add legal-notify@veritas.ai only if outage >4h.

lia-oncall: Status page update posted: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/p12345. CLI command used: `redwoodctl incidents update --id p12345 --status degraded --note "5xx spike; fallback routing enabled; rollback in progress"`

eng-sre-matt: rollback completed on 2/3 nodes, third node in progress. p95 latency trending down from 1.2s -> 420ms on nodes rolled back. Continuing to monitor KV cache and model hot-sharding.

incident-bot: Auto-escalation check: on-call handoff to lia-oncall acknowledged at 3344556800. Pager escalation window extended by 30m.

ops-lead-kate: Internal ops snippet for post-mortem / customer comms (paste into internal thread):
```
Impact: Veritas-AI dedicated pool in eu-west-1 saw increased 5xx errors for inference requests due to GPU OOMs triggered by a kernel runtime change.
Mitigation: Immediate rollback of kernel change, enabled fallback routing to shared-eu pool, scaled up two standby nodes.
Timeline: 00:00 alert -> 00:03 rollback start -> 00:18 partial recovery -> ongoing validation.
Next steps: finish rollback on remaining node, run full health checks, schedule canary of kernel patch in staging with extended observability.
Customer messaging: short blurb + commit to follow-ups and a detailed RCA within 72 hours.
```

support-amy: Sending tailored email to Veritas ops now (include the short blurb above + contact phones). Will cc acct-mgr-josh and eng-sre-matt.

acct-mgr-josh: I posted the customer contacts into the notification template and pinged their on-call. Veritas acknowledges receipt and asked for ETA; I gave 45m conservative.

lia-oncall: Monitoring looks stable for 8m after rollback on two nodes; no additional 5xx spikes. Keeping fallback routing active until full rollbacks complete. Will close this thread once all nodes healthy and customer notified with resolution. :white_check_mark:

support-amy: Final planned status update for customer at +30m:
"Update: We have rolled back a recently deployed runtime change and enabled fallback routing. Error rates have decreased and latency is improving. We will confirm full recovery within the next 30–45 minutes and send a follow-up"

lia-oncall: acknowledged, will post follow-up when resolved.

eng-sre-matt: adding note to runbook: include check for quantized-runtime memory regression after kernel upgrades.

lia-oncall: closing handoff to incident channel, continuing monitoring in private on-call DMs.
